title: Export orders as CSV from the web dashboard
description: Operations staff need to download the orders currently shown in the dashboard as a CSV file.

functional: The orders page shows an "Export CSV" button.
The exported file contains the columns id, customer, total and createdAt, in that order.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the orders page shows filtered results
acceptanceCriteria.then: a file named orders-<date>.csv is downloaded containing only the filtered orders

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The exported CSV opens correctly in common spreadsheet applications.

definitionOfDone: AC-2 is checked manually before release.
